load_tf_weights_in_gpt2: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch GPT-2 model from a given checkpoint path
GPT2Model_forward: run the bare GPT-2 transformer forward pass to get raw hidden states without any head on top
GPT2LMHeadModel_forward: run the GPT-2 language modeling forward pass with a linear LM head tied to input embeddings
GPT2DoubleHeadsModel_forward: run the GPT-2 model with both language modeling and multiple-choice classification heads for SWAG-style tasks
Attention_prune_heads: prune selected attention heads in a GPT-2 model layer to reduce compute and memory usage
